Home.heroSubtitle: India's trusted B2B agricultural marketplace for wild herbs, medicinal plants, and farm produce. Fair pricing, verified sellers, secure transactions.
Home.step1Desc: Create your account with mobile OTP verification. Farmers and buyers register with verified credentials.
Home.step2Desc: Farmers list their agricultural produce. Buyers browse verified listings with transparent pricing.
Home.step3Desc: Direct B2B connections with fair market pricing. Secure escrow-protected transactions.
Home.step4Desc: Build lasting business relationships. Access fair prices and expand your agricultural trade.
Home.why1Desc: Transparent market-linked pricing ensures farmers get what they deserve.
Home.why2Desc: Every farmer and buyer is verified by our admin team before trading.
Home.why3Desc: Escrow-protected payments keep both parties safe during trade.
Home.why4Desc: No middlemen. Farmers and buyers connect directly for better margins.
Home.footerTagline: Empowering India's agricultural value chain through technology and trust.
